useCases.title: DPPskop – Digital Product Passport Platform for ESPR Compliance
useCases.summary:
DPPskop is a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform that enables manufacturers to create, manage, validate, and publish Digital Product Passports (DPPs) in preparation for the European Union Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR).

The platform centralizes product information, sustainability data, supply chain documentation, carbon footprint records, repairability information, compliance documents, and Digital Product Passport content into a single structured digital identity.

Manufacturers can collaborate with suppliers, collect verified product data, publish QR-code-enabled Digital Product Passports, and continuously maintain product information throughout the product lifecycle.

DPPskop is designed to support interoperability with emerging European Digital Product Passport standards and validation initiatives, helping organizations prepare for future regulatory requirements while improving transparency across the value chain.
useCases.userJourney:
Manufacturers create Digital Product Passports using DPPskop by entering product information, sustainability metrics, technical documentation, and supply chain data.

Suppliers can securely contribute product-specific information through dedicated supplier portals, reducing manual data collection and improving data quality.

Once the required information is completed, the platform evaluates completeness and compliance, generates a Digital Product Passport, and publishes it through a QR code or GS1 Digital Link.

Different stakeholder groups—including consumers, business customers, recyclers, service providers, and regulatory authorities—can access different information views according to their authorization level.

The platform also supports continuous updates throughout the product lifecycle, allowing manufacturers to maintain accurate and up-to-date Digital Product Passports.
